description: The chart compares the win rates of different models, including GPT-4o, LLaMA, and Mistral, in a ring chart format. There are three slices in the outer ring, representing the win rates of these models, and one inner ring showing a single, aggregated value. The outer ring is divided into three sections: GPT-4o (blue, approximately 96.8%), Mistral (dark blue, approximately 1.2%), and LLaMA (light blue, approximately 3.2%). The inner ring is a single maroon-colored section labeled "Win rate (%)" with a value of 98.4% associated with GPT-4o. The chart includes labels for each slice, with percentage values annotated outside the chart, and the slices are visually distinct due to their different colors. The segments are arranged in descending order of their proportions.
